common_conditions: IWF group call request on IWF-1 between IWF and MCPTT server (§10.3.2.1–2)
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Caller MCPTT ID, interworking group ID and SDP offer are mandatory; alias, implicit floor request, broadcast indicator and location are optional.

conditions: LMR does not supply caller identity
claims.conclusion: May use MCPTT ID reserved for LMR user at IWF; not evidence of terminal-provided personal identity.
Include only when originating client requests floor.

limitations: Stage2 information elements, not SIP encoding or complete call/floor state machine.
